from hypergolic import (
    App,
    ApprovalContext,
    InputSchema,

    Tool,

)


class DeployInput(InputSchema):
    environment: Literal["staging", "production"]
    version: str


async def run_deploy(inp: DeployInput, ctx: ToolContext) -> ToolResult:
    text = f"Deployed {inp.version} to {inp.environment}."
    return ToolResult(content=[{"type": "text", "text": text}])


def deploy_approval(ctx: ApprovalContext) -> ToolApprovalDecision:
    if ctx.input.environment == "production":
        return ToolApprovalDecision(
            decision="REQUIRE_APPROVAL",
            context="Deploying to production",
        )
    return ToolApprovalDecision(decision="ALLOW")


deploy = Tool(
    id="deploy",
    name="Deploy",
    description="Deploy a tagged version to staging or production.",
    input_schema=DeployInput,
    run=run_deploy,
    approval=deploy_approval,
)

app = App()
app.use_defaults()

store = Project(
    id="acme-store",
    name="Acme Store",
    description="Inventory and pricing for the Acme storefront",
    git_root="~/code/acme-store",
)
store.register_tools([deploy])
app.register_project(store)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
